title: AliExpress: 20% Cashback on Affiliated Products (Uncapped) @ TopCashback UK
body:
Deal: AliExpress: 20% Cashback on Affiliated Products (Uncapped) @ TopCashback UK

[bboarder] I wish reolink store was still on aliexpress for these deals. Anyone know if there's other chinese brands worth a look for cameras, doorbells, smart locks etc?
[ATTS] Or even another retailer who discount the reo link cameras and nvr would be good too
[InfamousCalf] be wary of the tracking issues from the previous deal - https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/971616
[jamescd] I'm still waiting for cashback from a week ago that didn't track, they have said they will lodge it tomorrow. As it's a preorder I have a bit of time to let it ride, but will see what happens, and definitely something to be conscious of, especially if it's an item that will be sent before there is any chance to lodge a claim .
[bohn] I always cancel orders that do not track.
[InfamousCalf] I ordered and cancelled 3 times. There was a single listing that wouldn't track (Sennheiser ear pads). There's some issue with their system.
[bohn] That's annoying.
Lately I have found the phone gives the best success (using the app).
[sssx] My TCBUK AliExpress have always tracked including from the linked deal.
[dottjt] Gonna wait till they do 35% again, in no rush.
[Ironic fear] True but if you just ordered in the 35% cashback and stacked with the AliExpress team cashback then you will have 5-10% as credit to use within like 30ish days, so this is probably the best there'll be in that time.
[dottjt] Ah interesting. Although that still wouldn't be as good as 35% cashback though, right?
Edit: Oh wait, does that mean I can just use the credit by itself?
[Ironic fear] Re the edit: Yes you can use the credit by itself. Whilst 20% obviously isn't as good as 35%, if you have literally free money as credit and you have some smaller purchase to make it's pretty good.
[Feeblely] It only gets credit once its fully delivered to your house
[internet-stranger] Interesting. I have credit that’s available to spend once it’s marked as shipped.
[Ironic fear] I really don't think this is true, at least not for all items. Mine are available to spend now from the 35% cashback and none have been delivered.
Maybe it's high value items or high return rate items that delay it?
[basketballfreak6] Just made a purchase and it seems like TCB only tracks what you actually spent and not the total amount with the store credit (which was a bit of a bummer) so it definitely makes sense to try to use up the store credit before it expires regardless of the cashback rate.
[outlander] Sweet. I always find things to order once a big discount expires, and the big discounts always seem to coincide with major life events
[Ace26] My TCB uk account is asking for a local phone number. How does one get around that?
[cheng2008] Hmm why does it say 15% cashback? I don't see 20% anywhere on TCB page.
[team teri] I only see 15% on the UK site. Anyone get 20%?
[cryptos] Shows 20% when logged out, switches to 15% on login…
[ozstig] If you are a PLUS member it's 20%, CLASSIC member rate is 15%
[Cirrus123] did not track my last one and I've had to submit a claim. always a stupid pita.
[JustWantToSave] Thanks OP.
Burning through my money with all these aliexpress cashback deals.
All my orders on TCB AU and UK have tracked over the last few days of shopping.
Kinda wild how much faster it tracks than other offers through TCB.
[josh4you] How do you withdraw the UK cashback in AU account?
[team teri] For best exchange rate: Wise.
If you can't be bothered to shop around: PayPal
